publication.title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT

sources.primary_authority: The accepted paper takes precedence when its reported experiment values conflict with repository launch defaults.
sources.conflict_note: At the audited commit, main.sh launches LoRA at 1e-3, while the accepted paper explicitly reports and justifies 1e-4 for PEFT. The launcher also passes --tuning although config.py accepts --tuning_mode, and its filename says noWD while train.py applies 0.01 weight decay. This profile gives the accepted paper priority for reported values and uses train.py for settings absent from the paper.

paper_exact.adapter_lr: Appendix C, Table 6 and accompanying text: PEFT learning rate 1e-4.
paper_exact.early_stopping_patience: Appendix C, Table 6: 5, selected by validation F1.
paper_exact.min_lr_factor: Appendix C: cosine learning-rate decay to zero.
paper_exact.gradient_checkpointing: Appendix C: enabled for image and text encoders.
paper_exact.conv_lora_rank: Table 2 and Appendix C: image ConvLoRA rank 2.
paper_exact.conv_lora_alpha: Table 2 and Appendix C: image ConvLoRA scaling factor 2.

official_code_backed.encoder_weight_decay: train.py passes weight_decay=0.01; exclusions and LLDR in the source implementation are not fully reproduced by this classifier optimizer.
official_code_backed.warmup_epochs: train.py calls the scheduler with warmup_steps=0.
official_code_backed.max_grad_norm: The audited training loop performs no gradient clipping; zero disables clipping here.

supervised_classifier_adaptations.head_lr: The publication has projection layers rather than this classifier head; the publication PEFT learning rate is used.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.dropout_prob: The publication has no equivalent classifier dropout; zero avoids adding publication-unsupported dropout.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.head_weight_decay: The official code applies 0.01 to eligible projection matrices; the same value is adapted to this classifier head.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.min_delta: The official code uses strict F1 improvement, represented as zero.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.embedding_dim: The classifier input follows Merlin's 2048-dimensional image representation.
supervised_classifier_adaptations.train_image_projection: Section 2.4.2 trains the final image projection, so the profile requests it. In this project Merlin(ImageEmbedding=True) returns the raw 2048-dimensional pooled feature before contrastive_head, and the current projection-name matcher does not find contrastive_head; this flag therefore does not reproduce the publication's trainable projection.

known_methodological_differences: The publication's complete PEFT method combines image ConvLoRA with text LoRA rank 16, alpha 32, and dropout 0.2; this vision-only classifier has no text encoder.
The publication trains a joint image-text VLM with InfoNCE; this project trains a supervised image classifier.
The publication learns contrastive temperature and evaluates initial values 0.07, 0.5, 1.0, and 10.0; this classifier has no temperature parameter.

The publication trains its 512-dimensional contrastive image projection. Merlin(ImageEmbedding=True) bypasses that projection in this project, so train_image_projection=true is retained as publication intent but is currently ineffective.
The official code uses layer-wise learning-rate decay of 0.7 and steps its scheduler per minibatch; the current classifier uses adapter/head optimizer groups and steps its scheduler per epoch.
The official code excludes normalization parameters and biases from weight decay; the current classifier optimizer applies weight decay per adapter/head group.
The publication stops on validation F1 alone; this project selects and stops on 0.7*macro-F1 + 0.3*balanced accuracy.

The official code accumulates unscaled minibatch losses and does not flush a partial accumulation at the epoch boundary; this project divides loss by the accumulation count and flushes the final partial accumulation.
The publication uses FP16 mixed precision. Supply --amp to match that runtime setting.
